# jquants-api

> Unofficial async Rust client for the J-Quants API v2 (Japanese stock market data by
> JPX Market Innovation & Research). Covers all 25 data endpoints: equity bars, listed
> company master, financial statements, margin trading, short selling, derivatives,
> indices (TOPIX), timely disclosure, and bulk download. Requires a J-Quants API key.

## Setup

```toml
[dependencies]
jquants-api = "0.1"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
```

Auth: get an API key at https://jpx-jquants.com/dashboard/api-keys (free plan works).

```rust
use jquants_api::{JQuantsClient, Plan};
let client = JQuantsClient::from_env()?;            // reads JQUANTS_API_KEY
let client = JQuantsClient::new("api-key");          // or pass directly
let client = client.with_base_url("http://...");     // override for tests
let client = client.with_http_client(reqwest_client); // custom timeout/proxy
let client = client.with_plan(Plan::Free);           // rate limit to the plan's quota
let client = client.with_rate_limit(30);             // or a custom requests/minute (0 = off)
```

All methods are `async` and must be awaited. Errors are `jquants_api::Error`:
`Http(reqwest::Error)` | `Api { status: u16, message: String }` |
`Decode { source, body }` | `MissingApiKey`.

## Core concepts

- Pagination (`pagination_key`) is followed automatically; methods return ALL pages merged.
- `CursorPage<T> { items: Vec<T>, cursor: Option<String> }` is returned by cursor
  endpoints (`fins_summary`, `fins_details`, `td_list`). Persist `cursor` and pass it
  in the next query's `cursor` field to fetch only the delta since last call.
- `FlexString`: wraps fields the API returns as string OR number OR null.
  Deref to `&str`; use `.as_f64() -> Option<f64>` for numeric use; null becomes `""`.
- Query structs implement `Default`; set only needed fields with `..Default::default()`.
  Dates are strings, `YYYY-MM-DD` or `YYYYMMDD`.
- HTTP 210 from the API means "data not yet available"; methods return what was
  accumulated so far (possibly empty Vec) instead of an error.

## Methods (on JQuantsClient)

Equities:
- `master(&MasterQuery { code, date }) -> Vec<StockMaster>` — listed company master
- `daily_bars(&CodeDateQuery { code, date, from, to }) -> Vec<DailyBar>` — daily OHLCV,
  raw + adjusted (`adj_close` etc.), morning/afternoon session fields
- `am_bars(Option<&str /*code*/>) -> Vec<AmBar>` — morning-session close snapshot
- `minute_bars(&CodeDateQuery) -> Vec<MinuteBar>` — minute bars (plan-gated)
- `earnings_calendar() -> Vec<EarningsCalendar>` — earnings announcement schedule
- `investor_types(&InvestorTypesQuery { section, from, to }) -> Vec<InvestorType>`

Markets:
- `breakdown(&CodeDateQuery) -> Vec<Breakdown>` — trade value/volume breakdown
- `trading_calendar(&CalendarQuery { holiday_division, from, to }) -> Vec<Calendar>`
- `margin_alert(&CodeDateQuery) -> Vec<MarginAlert>` — daily margin publication
- `margin_interest(&CodeDateQuery) -> Vec<MarginInterest>` — weekly margin balance
- `short_ratio(&ShortRatioQuery { s33, date, from, to }) -> Vec<ShortRatio>`
- `short_sale_report(&ShortSaleReportQuery { code, disc_date, disc_date_from, disc_date_to, calc_date }) -> Vec<ShortSaleReport>`

Indices:
- `index_daily_bars(&CodeDateQuery) -> Vec<IndexDailyBar>`
- `topix_daily_bars(&RangeQuery { from, to }) -> Vec<TopixDailyBar>`

Derivatives:
- `futures_bars(&FuturesBarsQuery { category, date, contract_flag }) -> Vec<FuturesBar>`
- `options_bars(&OptionsBarsQuery { category, code, date, contract_flag }) -> Vec<OptionsBar>`
- `options_225_bars(Option<&str /*date*/>) -> Vec<Options225Bar>` — Nikkei 225 options

Financials:
- `fins_summary(&FinsQuery { code, date, cursor }) -> CursorPage<FinsSummary>` (cursor)
- `fins_details(&FinsQuery) -> CursorPage<FinsDetails>` (cursor) — `fs` field is raw serde_json::Value
- `fins_dividend(&CodeDateQuery) -> Vec<FinsDividend>`
- `fins_earnings_date(&EarningsDateQuery { code, date, scheduled_date }) -> Vec<EarningsDate>`
  — exactly one of code/date/scheduled_date is required by the API

EDINET (Standard plan or higher; add-on data):
- `edinet_major_shareholders(&EdinetQuery { edinet_code, code, date }) -> Vec<MajorShareholdersDoc>`
- `edinet_cross_shareholdings(&EdinetQuery) -> Vec<CrossShareholdingsDoc>`
- `edinet_large_volume_shareholders(&EdinetQuery) -> Vec<LargeVolumeShareholdersDoc>`
- Note: edinet_code and code cannot be specified together.

Timely disclosure:
- `td_list(&TdListQuery { date, code, from, to, disc_items, cursor }) -> CursorPage<TdList>`
  — `date` or `code` is required; the response carries no cursor in practice.
- `td_bulk() -> TdBulk { last_updated, url }` — one gzipped CSV with the last 5 years
- `td_files(disc_no: &str, docs: Option<&str>) -> TdFiles` — PDF/XBRL URLs, one
  disclosure per call (`date`/`code` are rejected; passing two `discNo` returns only
  the last one). `TdFiles::files` is `Option` because it comes back `null` when the
  disclosure has no documents at all (`TdList::docs` empty) — AGM convocation notices
  and the like, roughly 700 out of 770k over 5 years.

Bulk download (for large ranges; prefer over looping single calls):
- `bulk_list(&BulkListQuery { endpoint, date, from, to }) -> Vec<BulkListItem>`
- `bulk_get(&BulkGetQuery { key, endpoint, date }) -> String` — presigned file URL
- Tick data (`/equities/trades`) is CSV-only per the API spec — there is NO JSON method;
  fetch it via bulk_list/bulk_get with endpoint "/equities/trades".

## Common pitfalls

- Free plan data is ~2 years with a 12-week delay; querying newer dates returns an
  Api error or empty data. Light=5y, Standard=10y, Premium=full history. Check
  https://jpx-jquants.com/ja/spec/data-spec for endpoint/plan availability.
- Rate limiting is OFF by default. Enable it with `with_plan(Plan::Free|Light|Standard|Premium)`
  (5/60/120/500 requests per minute, per the official pricing as of 2026-08) or
  `with_rate_limit(n)`. The limiter waits (never errors) and also throttles each internal
  pagination request. On `Api { status: 429 }` back off anyway.
  For bulk historical loads use `bulk_list`/`bulk_get` instead of looping daily_bars.
- `CodeDateQuery::code("7203")` is a shortcut for code-only queries.
- Stock codes are strings; the API uses both 4-digit ("7203") and 5-digit ("72030")
  representations depending on endpoint — pass what the API docs specify.
- Do NOT redistribute fetched data; J-Quants terms restrict usage to personal analysis.

## Example

```rust
use jquants_api::{CodeDateQuery, JQuantsClient};

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), jquants_api::Error> {
    let client = JQuantsClient::from_env()?;
    let bars = client
        .daily_bars(&CodeDateQuery {
            code: Some("7203".into()),
            from: Some("2026-01-01".into()),
            ..Default::default()
        })
        .await?;
    for b in &bars {
        println!("{} close={:?} adj_close={:?}", b.date, b.close, b.adj_close);
    }
    Ok(())
}
```
